lines.zh: 我提着自己的手腕往前走。
lines.en: I lift my own wrist and walk.

lines.zh: 每一步都像有人在拉线。
lines.en: Every step feels like a string being pulled.

lines.zh: 我的步子轻，不碰出声响。
lines.en: My steps are light and make no sound.
I slide past the side of the stage.
I walk straight, without bending.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂着，指尖朝下。
lines.en: My arms hang, fingertips down.

lines.zh: 我绕过游戏机，转得很顺。
lines.en: I round the arcade cabinet smoothly.
I pass close along the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在地砖上很轻。
lines.en: My steps are light on the tiles.
I slow so the lamp catches me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，空气变凉。
lines.en: The air cools where I pass.
I walk on without looking back.
My shadow is thin as a string.

lines.zh: 我立在那里，手臂微微抬着。
lines.en: I stand with my arms slightly raised.
By day I'm only decor.

lines.zh: 我的脸没有表情，一直如此。
lines.en: My face shows nothing. It always has.
I listen to the room's echo.
The tubes buzz above my head.
I stay still and quiet.
Someone laughs far off. Not I.

lines.zh: 我数着这间屋里的座位。
lines.en: I count the seats in this room.
There's a ring mark on my wrist.
The light slides off my face.

lines.zh: 我在等今天的最后一位客人。
lines.en: I wait for today's last guest.
My joints are thin as sticks.
I keep my head up, watching the ceiling.
By day I keep to the rules.

lines.zh: 我不需要坐，也不需要休息。
lines.en: I need neither seat nor rest.

lines.zh: 你从门口进来时，我就看见你了。
lines.en: I saw you the moment you came in.
Don't stay here too long.

lines.zh: 白天我不会动，这不代表什么。
lines.en: I don't move by day. That means little.

lines.zh: 你的脸，和我想的不太一样。
lines.en: Your face isn't quite what I pictured.

lines.zh: 我在看你有没有注意门。
lines.en: I'm watching whether you mind the door.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，照不到角落。
lines.en: Your lamp can't reach the corners.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我只是立在这里。
lines.en: Don't touch me; I'm only standing here.
Don't blink while you look at me.

lines.zh: 这里每扇门我都知道通向哪。
lines.en: I know where every door here leads.
Do you hear the music?
My face is painted on.
You're a bit far. Come closer.

lines.zh: 这个时间，客人应该少一点。
lines.en: At this hour there should be fewer guests.
Your shadow falls at my feet.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，没有别的意思。
lines.en: I'm only watching you. Nothing more.
Close the door when you leave.

lines.zh: 他们在后面说你什么，你听见了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear what they say about you back there?
By day I'm very patient.

lines.zh: 你的手在口袋里，握着什么。
lines.en: Your hand is in your pocket. What's in it?
I lift my eyes to your shoes.
My arm has been pulled out of joint.
That tilted me half an inch.

lines.zh: 白漆剥落，露出下面黑色的骨。
lines.en: White paint flakes off, showing black bone beneath.

lines.zh: 我的头偏了，慢慢正回来。
lines.en: My head tilts and slowly rights.
It hurts, but my face doesn't change.
One of my joints cracks.
I step back, steady.
You hit harder than I expected.

lines.zh: 天亮我就站着不动，晚上再说。
lines.en: By day I stand still; at night we'll see.

lines.zh: 我的线被扯直，可我还立着。
lines.en: My strings pull taut, but I am still upright.
That light makes me want to rise.
You've set it on the counter.
I turn my head slowly aside.
That sound comes from your side.
You've left the door ajar.

lines.zh: 我往前倾了一点，又停住。
lines.en: I lean forward, then stop.
Someone pressed a switch in here.
Your steps are steady. I like that.
That coat is a very dark color.
I wait for one more step from you.

lines.zh: 音乐响起来的时候，我会抬头。
lines.en: When the music starts, I lift my head.
You dimmed the lamp. Good.
I reach out; just short.

lines.zh: 这一点动静，让我站直了。
lines.en: That small noise makes me stand straight.

lines.zh: 我听见帘子后面的呼吸。
lines.en: I hear breathing behind the curtain.
Wait; the hour isn't here yet.

lines.zh: 那只八音盒，响一声我就转过来。
lines.en: That music box: one note and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 白天我站在展台上，不动。
lines.en: By day I stand on the display, still.

lines.zh: 我的手臂被你碰得摇了一下。
lines.en: My arm swings slightly from your touch.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，动作很僵硬。
lines.en: I turn aside, stiffly.
Don't pull my wrist.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你反而退了一步。
lines.en: We collide, and you're the one who steps back.

lines.zh: 我的指尖划过你的袖子。
lines.en: My fingertips rake your sleeve.
I lean back until I touch the wall.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我身上掉了点漆。
lines.en: That knocked a little paint off me.
You step right beside my foot.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，你可以过去。
lines.en: I give half a step; you may pass.
Another stands under the lamp.

lines.zh: 我们摆着一模一样的姿势。
lines.en: We hold an identical pose.
Its face is whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，像两面镜子。
lines.en: We stand like two mirrors.
Its wrist carries the same mark.
Two strings hold us. No words needed.
The lamp lights us; neither moves.
It tilts its head toward me.
By day there are only the two of us.
At night we walk together.
I bend and pick up a coin.
I pinch up the ticket on the floor.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
I'll keep this bit of confetti.
I pick it up and study it a while.
It's light as paper.
I set it on the counter.

lines.zh: 我用细长的手指夹起一张票根。
lines.en: I pinch a ticket stub between my long fingers.
I close my fingers slowly.
This carries your scent.

lines.zh: 展示位上，我一动也不动。
lines.en: On the display stand, I don't move at all.
The lights are on. I don't mind.
You knocked my pose askew.

lines.zh: 我记住你站在哪块砖上。
lines.en: I've noted which tile you stand on.
Take one look back.
I begin to draw in my strings.
You've come to my side now.
I'm waiting for you to close the door.
This time I'll stop pretending.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的范围里。
lines.en: Your shadow has entered my reach.
Still by day. I move at night.

lines.zh: 我的线绷紧了，脖子先转向你。
lines.en: My strings draw tight and my neck turns to you first.
All the doors in this room are far.
The lamps begin to flicker.
You're against the wall with nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我的影子和你连在一起。
lines.en: My shadow has joined yours.
I'm slow, but I never stray.

lines.zh: 你听见线绷紧的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the strings tightening?
I'll be a little faster than you think.
I raise my hand, and the strings move.

lines.zh: 我的指尖从你肩头划下。
lines.en: My fingertips draw down your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，直直地劈下。
lines.en: I raise my arm and chop straight down.

lines.zh: 你退了，我跟着往前一步。
lines.en: You back off; I take one step.
I press you against the arcade machine.

lines.zh: 我的关节顶到你的胸口。
lines.en: My joint jabs your chest.
You block, but your hands shake.
I sweep with my whole arm.
You knock over a chair.

lines.zh: 你跌坐在地上，抬头看我。
lines.en: You fall sitting and look up at me.

lines.zh: 我长臂扫过，把你推向游戏机。
lines.en: My long arm sweeps and shoves you into the arcade cabinet.

lines.zh: 展示区的灯亮了，我在了。
lines.en: The display lights come on, and I'm here.
Someone props me against the wall.

lines.zh: 大厅里多了一个高个子。
lines.en: A tall figure has joined the hall.

lines.zh: 我从布帘后被人推出来。
lines.en: I'm pushed out from behind the cloth curtain.

lines.zh: 这里白天需要一个人站着。
lines.en: This place needs someone standing by day.

lines.zh: 彩灯亮起，我的长影投到幕布上。
lines.en: The party lights come on and my long shadow falls on the curtain.

lines.zh: 音乐起了一个音，我抬头。
lines.en: One note of music, and I look up.
The bell rang, so I took my place.
Someone straightened my sleeve.

lines.zh: 披萨店的灯一盏盏亮起来。
lines.en: The pizzeria lamps light up one by one.
Fire sears my sleeve.
When I fall, my limbs sprawl.

lines.zh: 水进了我的关节，转不动。
lines.en: Water's in my joints; they won't turn.
The blast throws me onto the counter.
Something pins my shoulder.
That spell freezes me whole.

lines.zh: 我撑了太久，快没力气了。
lines.en: I've lasted too long; my strength is gone.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的脸都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and even my face lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拉下去，线断了。
lines.en: The void pulls me down, and the strings snap.
